correctness.rationale: Exact first-arrival decomposition into the five distinguished cycle/tail vertices and remaining tail vertices yields recurrence (1) for all n>=5. The path generating function is derived independently from its recurrence. Formal-power-series algebra yields the chord sensitivity function and coefficient increment. Alternating strictly decreasing increments for n>=6 prove positivity for every n>=7 and the factorial remainder. Standalone verify.py confirms 516 exact assertions, including independent induced-subgraph and permutation enumeration checks. Finite computations do not substitute for the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The path is an extremal base graph for greedy independent-set occupancy among trees. A single edge producing the smallest even cycle is the canonical bipartite unicyclic perturbation. The complete finite-order response has non-obvious equality orders n=4,6 and strict positive sign thereafter; the stable shift is explicitly (1-7 exp(-2))/2 with factorial corrections. This resolves a natural structural boundary and not an arbitrary parameter slice or a known-table recomputation.
